newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BOURSE HEX INDEX HITS LIFE-HIGH 2,349.26.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BOURSE HEX INDEX HITS LIFE-HIGH 2,349.26.

text.p: Boosted by a sharp rise in telecoms blue-chip Nokia Oy , the Helsinki Stock Exchange's HEX all-share index soared on Thursday to a life-high 2,349.26 points -- up 37 percent this year.

On Wednesday, prior to the release Thursday midday of Nokia's January-September results, the HEX closed at 2,263.32 points, nearly 83 points or 3.5 percent below the previous life-high of 2,346.26 set September 15, 1995.
As the HEX hit its new peak, Nokia had advanced 27.00 markka or almost 12 percent to 254.00 markka in hectic trade.
Turnover on the Helsinki bourse was a heavy 930 million markka of which 77 percent was in Nokia.
A Reuters poll made before the release of Nokia's Q3 report showed that the HEX was expected to rise some 33 percent this year to around 2,280 by the end of 1996.

The polled analysts' mean forecast for Nokia's A share price at end-1996 was 240.00 markka. At 1630/1430 GMT, Nokia A traded at 250.00 markka, up 23.00 markka or 10.1 percent, having touched 254.00 markka.
